notes: Merged selected rules into references/typescript.md: as only after validation, the schema library of the repository, branded primitives, kind unions, non-empty tuples, Pick/Omit/ReturnType instead of custom mapped types, object arguments for 3 or more parameters or 2 of the same type, a never variable named unhandled, and no console.log. Left out the Real tests rule, because unit tests stub collaborators (see dot-testing). Also condensed pstack/skills/principle-boundary-discipline and pstack/skills/principle-type-system-discipline at the same commit. The rest of the reference is based on the Google TypeScript style guide.
